preparation.rule: Before timing: exact state/output/Q8 parity and graph replay; eager SG32 fused-Q8, 36 independent layer states, A/B/A/B/A, 3 warmups and 9 retained samples of 8 full layer sweeps/arm. A paired shape is eligible only when both adjacent baseline medians drift <=3%. All shapes must be eligible; every no-prefix shape gain >=-1%, pooled no-prefix gain >=1%, every prefix shape gain >0%. Highest geometric gain screens into two fresh confirmation processes; both must individually pass the same rule. Final source and independently renamed original must then pass fresh correctness and two confirmation processes plus existing GDN regression. No deployment.
